top_signals.title: Fed’s Musalem Says Economy to Likely Require ‘Several’ Hikes by Spring
top_signals.summary: Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis President Alberto Musalem signaled support for multiple interest rate-increases in the coming months. He said, “the economy will likely require several interest rate increases before the spring of 2027 to achieve price stability in a timely manner” during comments Tuesday in Argentina. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.summary: Two of Anthropic PBC’s biggest customers will have about 28% of its stock in aggregate after it goes public, adding to the close links between the companies powering the artificial intelligence boom.
